cases.name: etaf-gamekit-godot-preserves-batched-input-order
cases.purpose: A full burst of native commands acknowledges every input and preserves its order.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-godot-project-controls-stream-cadence
cases.purpose: A project selects autonomous observation cadence without changing its simulation clock.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-godot-rejects-invalid-stream-rates
cases.purpose: Invalid Godot publication settings fail startup with an actionable error.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-large-observations-remain-detached
cases.purpose: A large flat native tensor remains usable without consuming Lisp call depth.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-game-definitions-create-independent-instances
cases.purpose: A game definition creates independent worlds and supplies its view metadata.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-backend-registration-preserves-owned-games
cases.purpose: Replacing/removing an adapter affects future starts without taking live games.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-game-configurations-are-validated-and-detached
cases.purpose: Game options are detached data; invalid definitions and overrides fail clearly.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-games-route-actions-to-different-native-kernels
cases.purpose: Game definitions run boardgame.io turns and OpenSpiel poker through one API.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-game-snapshots-restore-through-the-same-action-api
cases.purpose: Opaque native/replay snapshots restore observations without frontend parsing.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-transport-fragments-detached-values-and-bounded-input
cases.purpose: Fragments decode safely, reads detach ownership and eight inputs retain order.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-transport-coalesces-to-the-newest-visible-frame
cases.purpose: A burst preserves the final backend observation and displayed characters.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-transport-rejects-stale-invalid-and-dead-peers
cases.purpose: Invalid schemas, stale replies, oversized messages and dead peers fail clearly.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-schema-validator-errors-fail-the-session
cases.purpose: A supplied validator failure is reported with connection state and context.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-close-unmount-and-buffer-death-release-the-child
cases.purpose: Explicit close, unmount and buffer death release the child idempotently.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-observations-preserve-an-action-rejection
cases.purpose: An unsolicited display frame cannot erase the last action's rejection.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-openspiel-bot-answers-for-the-side-to-move
cases.purpose: The adapter plays a requested search move for the side to move through the public action API, with its decision reported and undoable.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-bot-policies-follow-the-game
cases.purpose: The search policy rejects a game without an evaluation while the random policy plays any turn-based kernel.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-frame-canvas-shows-changed-strips
cases.purpose: A published frame description shows one strip image per row, and republishing replaces only the rows whose serial changed.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-frame-canvas-uses-text-without-native-frames
cases.purpose: A text geometry shows the caller's fallback text and follows its updates without native frames.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-godot-publishes-only-changed-frame-strips
cases.purpose: The shared Godot frame publisher writes one strip per changed row, describes their ids and leaves unchanged rows unwritten.

cases.name: etaf-gamekit-hosted-session-mounts-nothing-and-still-publishes
cases.purpose: A session started with :display nil leaves its buffer unmounted so one host is the only rendering, while its state and reactive view still publish.
